name: Divergence for Many Indicators v4 ST
author: LonesomeTheBlue
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): prd = input(defval = 9, title = "Pivot Period", minval = 1, maxval = 50); source = input(defval = "Close", title = "Source for Pivot Points", options = ["Close", "High/Low"]); searchdiv = input(defval = "Regular", title = "Divergence Type", options = ["Regular", "Hidden", "Regular/Hidden"]); showindis = input(defval = "Don't Show", title = "Show Indicator Names", options = ["Full", "First Letter", "Don't Show"]); showlimit = input(1, title="Minimum Number of Divergence", minval = 1, maxval = 11); maxpp = input(defval = 10, title = "Maximum Pivot Points to Check", minval = 10, maxval = 20); maxbars = input(defval = 100, title = "Maximum Bars to Check", minval = 100, maxval = 200); shownum = input(defval = true, title = "Show Divergence Number"); showlast = input(defval = false, title = "Show Only Last Divergence"); dontconfirm = input(defval = false, title = "Don't Wait for Confirmation"); showlines = input(defval = false, title = "Show Divergence Lines"); showpivot = input(defval = false, title = "Show Pivot Points"); calcmacd = input(defval = true, title = "MACD"); calcmacda = input(defval = true, title = "MACD Histogram"); calcrsi = input(defval = true, title = "RSI"); calcstoc = input(defval = true, title = "Stochastic"); calccci = input(defval = true, title = "CCI"); calcmom = input(defval = true, title = "Momentum") | Indicator calls: sma(close, 50); sma(close, 200); rsi(close, 14); macd(close, 12, 26, 9); cci(close, 10); sma(stoch(close, high, low, 14); sma(Cmfv, 21); sma(volume,21); pivothigh((source == "Close" ? close : high); pivotlow((source == "Close" ? close : low)
exit: Source rule: strategy.position_size  exceeds  0; order: strategy.exit(id="Close Long", stop=longStop, limit=longTake); Source rule: strategy.position_size  is below  0; order: strategy.exit(id="Close Short", stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
stop_loss: strategy.exit(id="Close Long", stop=longStop, limit=longTake); strategy.exit(id="Close Short", stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
take_profit: strategy.exit(id="Close Long", stop=longStop, limit=longTake); strategy.exit(id="Close Short", stop=shortStop, limit=shortTake)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Pivot/fractal conditions can be confirmed only after right-side bars; confirm signal timestamp and avoid hindsight fills. Higher-timeframe/security or repaint behavior requires independent causal review.
